categories.main_business_segments: SuperAlloy Industrial Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the production and sales of forged aluminum alloy wheels and suspension system components for the automotive industry. The company also develops and manufactures aerospace components, metal forging products, molds, steel rebar couplers, and provides related import-export and agency services. It focuses on lightweight forged products and sustainable recycled aluminum materials for various industries including automotive, semiconductor, heavy electrical, aerospace, and electric vehicles.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced forging technologies including net-shape forging and CNC machining, supported by CAD/CAM software for product and mold design. It employs AI models for product development, production automation, and quality inspection. The production process includes horizontal continuous casting molds, dynamic CFD airflow analysis for wheels, robotic spraying for mold release agents, and five-axis machining. It also develops new surface treatment processes and forges magnesium alloy wheels.
categories.primary_customers_markets: SuperAlloy serves major global luxury automotive brands such as Ferrari, Porsche, McLaren, Bentley, Aston Martin, Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Jaguar & Land Rover, Lexus, Lotus, and electric truck manufacturer Workhorse. Its products are primarily used in the automotive sector, including electric and hybrid vehicles, with expanding applications in aerospace, semiconductor equipment, heavy electrical, and other mobile industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with manufacturing facilities in Yunlin and Pingtung. Its sales markets are global, with significant exports to Europe (over 59% of sales), North America (about 15.5%), and domestic sales accounting for around 25%. It maintains a European subsidiary, SuperAlloy Manufaktur GmbH, for local manufacturing and sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: SuperAlloy operates in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of forged aluminum wheels and automotive components. It sources aluminum alloy raw materials from major suppliers and its own recycled aluminum production, supplying finished forged parts to automotive OEMs and tier-1 suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in forging process innovation, including net-shape forging to reduce process steps, development of larger and more complex forged wheels, and new surface treatments. It expands the use of recycled aluminum across multiple industries and integrates AI technology for production automation, quality control, and product development. Future plans include expanding recycled aluminum production capacity and applying forging technology to semiconductor equipment consumables.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of forged aluminum wheels, suspension components, recycled aluminum alloy ingots, and related automotive parts. The company also earns income from mold design and manufacturing services, and provides testing services for recycled aluminum materials to external customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: SuperAlloy is positioned as a leading supplier of high-quality forged aluminum wheels and components for luxury automotive brands, with a strong emphasis on lightweight and sustainable materials. It competes globally with other specialized forging companies and benefits from long-term partnerships with premium car manufacturers. Its integration of recycled aluminum and advanced forging technologies differentiates it in the market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, SuperAlloy reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$7.47 billion, a slight decrease of 4% from the previous year, with a net profit of NT$755 million and earnings per share of NT$3.30. The company has shown improved operating margins and profitability, driven by increased use of recycled aluminum and production efficiency. It maintains a strong financial structure with a debt-to-asset ratio below 44% and continues to invest in automation and capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: SuperAlloy offers high-strength, lightweight forged aluminum wheels and components tailored for luxury and electric vehicles, emphasizing environmental sustainability through the use of 100% recycled aluminum (RESAICAL®). Its products meet stringent quality and performance standards, supported by advanced design, forging, and surface treatment technologies. The company’s commitment to innovation, AI integration, and carbon footprint reduction provides customers with cost-effective, high-quality, and eco-friendly solutions.
